page.overview:
Who is Emissary?

Zebres the Emissary has only one purpose, which is to transform and combine with Cerebros to form Fortress Maximus's head.

The Emissary starts out as a "room" thing. Next, Cerebros flies up and turns into the head of the Emissary. He then turns into Fortress Maximus's head.
